english.title: Vote in person as proxy at parliamentary or local authority election when entitled to vote by post as proxy
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that you voted in person as proxy for an elector, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTOR..), at a

(A)_[parliamentary]_
(B)_[local government]_

election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), at which you were entitled to vote by post as proxy for that elector
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 61(3)(b) and (7) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

english.notes:
61(7) An offence under this section shall be an illegal practice but -
(a) the court before whom a person is convicted of any such offence may, if they think it just in the special circumstances of the case, mitigate or entirely remit any incapacity imposed by virtue of section 173; and (b) a candidate shall not be liable, nor shall his election be avoided, for an illegal practice under this section of any agent of his other than an offence under subsection (5) above.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
